Invoice

Invoice

Calculated automatically from the Sum column. Type in the TOTAL box on the receipt to overwrite it.

Tap a percentage or type an amount. It is taken off the total and shown under the table. Not used if you type the TOTAL by hand.

Rounds the total down to the nearest 5, 10, 50 or 100 and records the difference as a discount.

Wholesale uses the wholesale price from the Price list. Prices already on the receipt switch too, except ones you typed by hand.

Automatic fills each Sum from Qty × Price.

A cancelled receipt gets a big CANCELLED mark and is left out of your sales totals. Its number stays used.

A quotation is not counted in sales, debts or reports. Turning it into a sale keeps the same number, sets today's date and marks it Not paid.

Change any text on the receipt. It applies to every receipt, image, PDF and Excel file made on this phone. Leave a box empty to hide that line.

The logo shows at the top of the app. The app colour is picked in App colors and is remembered separately for each shop.

Each shop has its own receipts, customers, price list, receipt numbers, colours, backups and receipt text. Switching reloads the app.
